label: Python
description: Run a Python snippet. Declare the node's inputs and outputs inline: `ExecPython(x: Number) -> (result: String) { code: "..." }`. Every declared input is a Python variable of the same name; one that received nothing is `None`, so an optional input reads as `if problem is None`. A file input (Image, Audio, Video, Blob, File) arrives as a plain dict with `url` (a download link minted for this firing, never written to the journal, so do not look for it there), `filename`, `mimeType`, `sizeBytes` and `key`: read `photo['url']` and fetch it. Return a file on a file-typed output by returning that same dict. The code returns a dict keyed by output port name; a key set to None (or missing) emits no pulse on that port. Exceptions fail the node with the full traceback.
